official.title: Aalto Society & Networks area is hiring for AI-agent + human-participant experimental research
official.excerpt: Verified official posting (RCF project "Social networking in the era of artificially intelligent agents"): the group designs AI-supported experimental/observational methods, runs advanced online experiments and surveys with human participants (Empirica-like platforms) and AI-agent social simulations. Society & Networks research area: 8 faculty, ~30 students and postdocs; PI has a group of three PhD students. Current call is postdoc-level only.

manual.notes: TAG: future-recruitment-monitoring. Methodological family matches the applicant (controlled multi-user human experiments). A future doctoral opening in this area would likely be adjacent-to-strong fit. Monitor via Aalto collector runs; no action unless a doctoral call appears.
